description: Gear oil should be changed when the water content reaches 600 ppm.
Gear oil should be changed when the foam content after 10 minutes of settling exceeds 10 ml.
Gear oil should be changed when the particulate levels exceed ISO code 18/15.
Gear oil should be changed when the total acid number increases by more than 2.0 mg/g KOH over the new oil value.
